description: This file defines the RoleRepository interface which extends Spring Data's CrudRepository for performing CRUD operations on Role entities. It includes a method to find roles by their role name.

classes.name: RoleRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Role entities, providing CRUD operations and a custom method to find roles by role name.

methods.name: findByRole
methods.description: Finds a Role entity by its role name and returns an Optional containing the result.
